Class Subcommand

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.engine.interact.cmd.base.Command
com.j3d.engine.interact.cmd.args.Subcommand
All Implemented Interfaces:
Argument
Direct Known Subclasses:
AbstractTransform, AreaCmd, CameraInfoCmd, CopyCmd, DistanceCmd, EchoCmd, EndCmd, ExitCmd, FilesCmd, LineJoin, ListCmd, LookAtCmd, OrbitCmd, PasteCmd, QuickTranslateCmd, RandomUUIDCmd, RecordCmd, RunCmd, TeleportCmd, TestCmd, ToggleCmd, ToggleVisCmd, TriangleCmd, TypeOf, VolumeCmd
public class Subcommand extends Command implements Argument
Represents a command that is nested within another command, acting as both a Command in its own right and as an Argument to its parent command.

This class enables the creation of hierarchical command structures, such as git commit -m "message". In this example, commit would be a Subcommand of the main git command.

By default, a subcommand is considered a non-optional argument to its parent.
